name: ai-message
title: AI Message
description: A chat message bubble for a user or an assistant, with copy, retry and thumbs buttons that appear on hover and on keyboard focus.

props.name: from
props.description: Who wrote the message. Decides the side, the colors and whether feedback buttons show.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Shown beside the bubble, such as an avatar or an orb.

props.name: bubble
props.description: Draw the tinted bubble. Turn it off when the content brings its own surfaces.

props.name: copyText
props.description: Plain text for the copy button. Leave it out to hide the button.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a retry button when set.

props.name: onVote
props.description: Shows thumbs up and down on assistant messages when set.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
